scope: local manual human QA, no effects from this manifest

scenarios.name: app-clean-iam-kept
scenarios.scope: whole application scenario, not per-user purge
setup: drain local app ingress/worker; freeze on pending/unknown active operations
archive current app DB and fully decode pg_dump; retain original DB
create a fresh owned scenario database and apply maintained migrations
use same bot/org/issuer and canonical IAM clients; switch only app database configuration
restart only app and prove deployment binding, empty app registration/history/actions
exercise real bot registration; preserve IAM subject
scenarios.restore: drain app, snapshot scenario DB, restore original config database URL, restart same app configuration; original database never deleted

scenarios.name: iam-human-only
scenarios.scope: selected test human IAM identity only; app DB retained
setup: match exact IAM subject, organization and human type; deny service accounts/client principals
snapshot selected human/profile/links/grants and app references
explicit selected human delete/recreate through IAM Management API; never delete organization/project/clients/IDP/provider
retain app DB to exercise orphan/relink behavior; new IAM subject is not silently patched into app rows
scenarios.restore: IAM deletion cannot restore old subject with normal create; use isolated IAM snapshot/restore or distinct test human if exact old identity continuity is required

scenarios.name: both-clean
scenarios.scope: whole fresh app scenario plus selected IAM human reset
setup: preserve both original app database and IAM snapshot
perform selected-human reset and fresh whole app scenario, keeping service org/clients/provider
exercise real Telegram/prelink/OIDC registration; compare actual subject and counts
scenarios.restore: restore retained app config/database and supported isolated IAM snapshot together; no app FK purge

scenarios.name: reverse-create
scenarios.scope: human IAM-first then actual bot entry
setup: create selected test human through supported IAM API without inventing Telegram links
complete actual Telegram/OIDC/prelink flow with human phone confirmation
start actual bot or Mini App; canonical subject remains single; no fabricated webhook
scenarios.restore: retain receipts; switch back original scenario if isolation needed

local event role none/ambassador/administrator via authority prepare and separately human-reviewed confirm

specialist binding and knowledge moderation are separate authorities; no role inference from pass
scenarios.restore: supported role revoke/new version, preserving proposal and audit history
